_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY. The model_id values below are PLACEHOLDERS ('example-org/example-model'), not real OpenRouter model IDs. The assignment forbids hardcoding unverified model IDs, so you must copy this file to llm/models.json and fill in verified IDs from https://openrouter.ai/models before any real (paid) run. Execution mode (any run without --dry-run) refuses placeholder IDs by design; dry-run mode permits them so the whole pipeline can be exercised without an account or an API key.
_requirements: Provide at least TWO entries with DISTINCT providers (the 'provider' field, or distinct vendor prefixes in model_id). The forecast design compares provider arms, so a single-provider config is rejected with a warning.
_pricing_note: Prices are NOT hardcoded anywhere. Actual billed cost is taken from the API response when OpenRouter reports it (usage.cost). For pre-run estimates only, pass --price-input-per-mtok / --price-output-per-mtok using the current prices shown on the OpenRouter model page (they change; check them at run time).
